blanks.sentence: In China, the examples described are _____ and contain pork and cabbage.
blanks.section: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS — Dumplings around the world

blanks.sentence: Alongside rice and corn, _____ is one grain commonly used as a dough base.
Over time, cooks have changed the _____ to create local varieties.
The time and place of the first dumpling remain _____.
One proposed birthplace lies along the _____, which connected China with Central Asia and Turkey.
In Ghana, dumplings can add _____ to a meal and absorb its sauces.
Kenkey is a regular main food for the _____, although people eat it across Ghana.
One accompaniment is a _____; another is a dark sauce containing seafood.
The meal gives eaters a strong feeling of _____.
Preparation takes time: the maize is left in water for _____.

multipleChoice.question: What is the main point of the examples from China, Nepal, Ireland and Italy?
options: Dumplings from each place are normally eaten with a sauce.
Dumplings take different local forms across the world.
Dumplings from each place use the same kind of dough.
Dumplings are usually fried outside their place of origin.

multipleChoice.question: How does the description of dumplings distinguish the dough from the filling?
options: The dough determines the shape, while the filling determines the name.
The dough is always boiled, while the filling may be fried.
The dough is made from vegetables, while the filling is made from grains.
The dough surrounds the filling, which may contain very different foods.

multipleChoice.question: Besides adding substance to a Ghanaian dish, what other job can a dumpling do?
options: Take up sauce and juices from the dish.
Replace the dish's need for any sauce.
Help the dish stay warm throughout the meal.
Give the sauce its distinctive dark colour.

multipleChoice.question: What contrast is made between the two sauces eaten with kenkey?
options: One is a chilli sauce; the other is made mainly from maize.
One is served hot; the other is served only after the meal.
One is a chilli sauce; the other contains seafood and other proteins.
One is eaten across Ghana; the other belongs to a single tribe.

multipleChoice.question: If a manual worker cannot eat again for several hours, why might kenkey be a useful choice?
options: They can prepare it quickly before starting work.
They can eat it without another food or sauce.
They can buy it wherever they are working.
It can keep them feeling full for much of the day.

multipleChoice.question: Which detail about kenkey's ingredients is given after the interview?
options: Its dough is made from maize sourdough.
Its dough is made from wheat and potato.
Its filling is made from fish and shrimp.
Its filling is made from cabbage and pork.
